title: The Burnt Ghost
author: Emrys Nystrom
blurb: Tamsin Okonkwo, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
